Package com.nexuslink.plugin.codegen

Interface CodeGenerator

All Known Implementing Classes:
KafkaCodeGenerator, MqttCodeGenerator, RestCodeGeneratorProvider, SqlCodeGenerator
public interface CodeGenerator
Turns a protocol's request/connection object into a ready-to-run client snippet — the cross-protocol code-generation SPI.

Each protocol module contributes one implementation and registers it in META-INF/services/com.nexuslink.plugin.codegen.CodeGenerator; the UI discovers them through CodeGenRegistry and never names a protocol directly. Implementations are stateless and must be safe to call from any thread.

supports(Object) is what keeps the SPI type-safe without generics leaking into the registry: a generator claims only the request type it understands, so the registry can offer the user exactly the generators that apply to the object in hand.
